Want to avoid a mashed potato fight at the holiday dinner table? In a culture full of noise and division, the BEST gift we can give each other this Thanksgiving and Christmas is a thoughtful, calm, and Christ-centered conversation. In this podcast, learn from trusted Christian apologists who have spent years helping believers think clearly […]
